messages:
Linh Tran: Quick sync — proposing a 'warm handoff' pilot for postmortem action owners. Idea: a 15m weekly pulse + short sprintlet board for 7/30-day items + an IC warm-handoff rotation to avoid stalled fixes. Opinions?
Jamal Ortiz: sgtm. curious how lightweight we can keep this — don't want another big meeting.
Sara Kim: agree on lightweight. Could we force a tiny checklist per action: owner, target date, verification step, and status? then we can filter the board easily.
Mike Patel: sketching cadence proposal: immediate ack (within 24h), triage & assign (72h), actionable commit (7d for small fixes/30d for medium), verification window (30d). Communicate cadence in postmortem summary.
Linh Tran: exactly. here's a minimal timeline template I was thinking to paste into the PM summary:
```
- Acknowledged: <who> (24h)
- Owner assigned: <owner> (72h)
- Fix committed: <PR/CL> (7d / 30d)
- Verify & close: <verifier> (30d)
- Followup note: <link to status board>
```
Jamal Ortiz: neat. for recurring incident patterns, should we tag actions with a "recurrence" label and group in a weekly review?
Sara Kim: yes — tag `recurrence:pattern-<name>` and have the weekly pulse only surface recurrence-tagged items + >30d open items. keeps noise down.
incident-bot: Reminder: you can create a tracker issue with `/incident-track create` and it will auto-populate the PM fields.
Mike Patel: rotation thought: incident commander warm-handoff every 2 weeks. outgoing IC posts a 1-paragraph handoff: current high-risk action items, blocked owners, and next steps. New IC should ack in the channel within their first shift.
Linh Tran: proposed owners for pilot (first 4 weeks): Jamal = pilot coordinator, Sara = board steward, Mike = recurrence reviewer. I'll own the commute/communication template for postmortems.
Jamal Ortiz: action items from this thread — I'll prototype a condensed board (Trello/Jira dashboard) by Tue EOD and link it in the PM template.
Sara Kim: I'll add the `recurrence` labels and a saved filter for the weekly 15m pulse.
Mike Patel: I'll write the IC warm-handoff template (1-paragraph + action summary) and post it as a snippet in ops-docs.
Linh Tran: owners + deadlines: Jamal (board prototype) — due Tue EOD; Sara (labels & filter) — due Wed noon; Mike (hand-off snippet) — due Wed EOD; Linh (PM template update) — done by end of day today.
Jamal Ortiz: noted, will ping if I need clarity.
Sara Kim: small UX ask — make the board show a "next touch" column for items due this week, helps the pulse meeting be 15m max.
Mike Patel: +1. Also propose adding a tiny SLA: any action >30d must have a named verifier and a biweekly verification note.
Linh Tran: decision: run 4-week pilot with these roles, weekly 15m pulse (focused on recurrence + >30d items), IC warm-handoff every 2 weeks, and enforce the simple timeline template in PMs. We'll review pilot metrics at the end (closure velocity, number of blocked items, recurrence signals).
incident-bot: Scheduled reminder created: "Warm-handoff pulse" every Tue 09:30 for #incidents.
Jamal Ortiz: I'll post the prototype board link here once ready.
Linh Tran: thanks team — small, repeatable process beats heavy meetings. If nobody objects by EOD I’ll update the postmortem template and spin up the first pulse invite. :thumbsup:
Mike Patel: no objections from me.
Sara Kim: same.
Jamal Ortiz: go for it.
Linh Tran: closing note: if you spot any process smell during the pilot, flag it in this thread with the prefix "pilot-signal:" so we can iterate quickly.
